notes.title: Chronicles of Rodovia #12 - A word about our absence and hero advancing system
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑[hr][/hr]

Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png"]


We know it's been a while... [hr][/hr]
As you've surely noticed, it’s been a while since our last devlog; however, that doesn't mean our kingdom has become deserted! Nothing of the sort - we’ve actually been hard at work in our forges, workshops, and training grounds, fully immersed in developing the Crown of Greed project. 

At the same time, we want to assure you that we’re returning to a regular stream of updates straight from the kingdom of Rodovia, with some genuinely fascinating (some would say groundbreaking!) news on the horizon. Want to be one of the very first to know about them? If so, be sure to stay tuned with our Steam page and Discord server. And now...



Hero visual changes as they level up

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/ace1f101a8ab555fc2fec1e2ebfdaaf119ec732b.png"]


From zero to hero! Champions' advancing system 💪[hr][/hr]
Partnering with heroes, while not cheap and often difficult, is fundamental to the operation of any kingdom. Champions' actions are an extension of the ruler's will and strategy, which is why it is said that the destiny of a ruler’s reign depends on their cunning and strength. With that in mind, we don't want to rely on weak or inexperienced heroes, right? To carry out our tasks, we need true veterans who can cope with any challenge that lies ahead. But... how can we find them?



Gaining experience and leveling up

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/145c2c79e500c6ad42ca21a2d8d15020596d0729.gif"]



As is usually the case, the beginnings are humble. When your kingdom sets a new foothold in an unknown, hostile land, you will have to start (almost) from scratch. After constructing the first recruitment buildings, such as Barracks, Syndicate of the Sticky Fingers, or Hunter Camp, you will be able to recruit your first adventurers. Rookies, if you will. But fear not - sending them into the wild will undoubtedly forge true warriors… at least for those who make it back.


How can your heroes earn experience?[hr][/hr]
• Dealing damage (to enemies and enemy structures),

• Killing enemies,

• Healing allies (e.g., in the case of Enchantress),

• Training in buildings tailored to enhance their possibilities (this feature is still to be developed),

• Participating in team combat with other heroes,



Upgrading hero dwelling

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/64166e06365c7f19df8ed1a94f5b479b75599a70.gif"]



As you can see, true legends are made in the heat of battle, adventure, and exploration. Your heroes will gladly take on such expeditions - for the right reward, of course. Those who succeed will come back stronger… and you can always recruit new ones to replace those who don’t, right?


Each level of experience is crucial 📈[hr][/hr]
Now that we know how champions can gain their experience, let's see how it can benefit our cause. And so, each new hero level rewards them with a few points of attributes, which are crucial to their performance while completing quests. Attributes are the basic characteristics of adventurers that you can view in their character panel (after clicking on them). 


Example attributes:
• attack power, 

• attack speed, 

• agility, 

• vitality, 

• armor, 

• speed, 

• resistances,

• max stamina, 

• or even luck! 

 

The stronger the heroes, the more difficult challenges they can take on

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/cc14ded1ab6a120ec345cb31f9b57073d9227890.gif"]



Remember that each subsequent level requires more experience points to achieve it. You can track your hero's experience progress bar and level in their character panel.

 
Other bonuses from character development ⚔️[hr][/hr]
To help you distinguish your favorite veteran champions from the ordinary beginner adventurers, we decided to reward them with their own advanced looks. How does it work? 



After reaching the level-milestones, that is levels 10 and 20, their textures will be replaced with ones that represent their progression and higher rank compared to other heroes of the same class. This will make it easier to recognize them on the battlefield and, for example, support them with reinforcements or powerful spells. What's more, your advancing heroes (levels 5, 10, 15, and 20) will receive new immersive sounds.



However, if you think that experience alone, while important, is not enough, remember that you can also support your champions in your kingdom buildings. The Forge and its weapon and armor upgrades, the Marketplace offering artifacts, the Alchemist with his potions, the Arena, the Library - they all can be used to your heroes benefit. Remember about them when expanding your next cities, for a ruler’s reign is only as strong as the heroes who serve him!



Remember to help out your heroes through regular upgrades

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/dfcbf60268ae75f5099609b5f92886b7ff30a32a.gif"]


Thank you, your Majesty![hr][/hr]
We trust that the twelfth of the Chronicles of Rodovia series has sparked your eagerness to seize the throne and guide your kingdom to prosperity and glory! 

You can be sure that we will soon publish more interesting information and news about the game, just like the next parts of our Chronicles 😁 Stay hyped, stay tuned, and add Crown of Greed to your Steam wishlist. Thank you, Rulers!

notes.title: Chronicles of Rodovia #11 - Magic and Spells system
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]

Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


Today we will delve into the mysterious world of magic, where it is none other than the king himself - that is, you - who co-decides about the course of battles and events in his kingdom. The spells we will tell you about have very wide, varied applications, and their wise use can decide life or death... or even extra wealth! Let us open the magic tome and discover its secrets.

The magic system in Crown of Greed ⚡
[hr][/hr]
As you surely know, in the kingdom of Rodovia your subjects are endowed with free will, and it is they who decide where to go, what tasks to undertake, which enemies to face, or when to take a well-deserved rest. Their decisions are motivated by gold, the universal currency that speaks to all heroes out there.  

The magic system is no different. In a world where shiny coin rules, even casting spells has a gold price. Therefore, if you want to efficiently support your kingdom with special effects, you need to make sure your treasury can handle the extra burden. Good, now that we have that settled, let's dive into the magic itself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/ea16421976b4569672b3d0e67d3cf548e4203a43.png

How does it work? 🧙‍♂️
[hr][/hr]
Each hero class building not only allows for unit recruitment and valuable upgrades but also unlocks a unique spell specific to that hero dwelling. Be sure to take a good look at the panels of the Barracks, Hall of Fury, or other recruitment buildings - before you can research new spells, you will likely need to upgrade them to tier 2 or 3 first. When a new spell becomes available for research, buy it and wait a moment to gain access to it. All done! Now you can use is whenever you decide. But... how?

Open the radial spellcasting panel by selecting it from the castle panel, or by pressing the Q hotkey. There you will see your unlocked spells, description of their effects and cost of use (as in the screenshot above). Just click on the chosen spell, check its range, and then use it for your own purposes. Pretty intuitive, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/e7e4f4fb1a3086acef69678851958972cfd216f9.gif

Example spells and their effects ☄️
[hr][/hr]
And now, what everyone has been waiting for! Learn some sample spells that you can use to incinerate your enemies, support your units, or even collect instant taxes!

✨Teleport - Allows the caster to instantly transport a hero from one location to another. A very useful skill when the odds of battle are stacked against you!

✨Meteor Shower - Hurls a deadly fireball at your enemies, damaging them instantly and gives them a burning effect.

✨ Stone Skin - All player units in the selected area gain the Stone Skin effect, significantly increasing their defensive capabilities.

✨ Cure - Instantly treats the wounds of your units in the selected area, making them able to continue fighting and survive yet another adventure.

✨ Battle Rage - Your units in the selected area go into a battle frenzy, cutting down their enemies even more effectively. 

✨ Nature Wall - Creates an impassable wall of vines for about 30 seconds - neither the player units nor the enemy can pass through it. Use it wisely!

✨ Eye of the Forest - Removes the fog of war in the selected area, allowing you to discover the nefarious plans and locations of your enemies.

💀 The necrotic school of magic - This additional form of magic, which we will tell you more about in the future, allows you to cast incredibly powerful spells. With it, you can curse your enemies, resurrect your units, and even summon undead minions.


These are of course just examples, as your spellbook will contain many more powerful abilities. Over time, you will certainly learn to use them wisely and even increase their power, as the more of a given type of hero dwelling you have, the stronger the spell effect will be (in terms of damage, area of effect, cooldown or casting costs). And so, for example, Wasps will be much more effective if you have three druid buildings than if you have one. We are sure you get the idea.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/0a11885ad491b1b242e643abc5bec9caafc5c528.gif

Thank you, your Majesty!
[hr][/hr]
We trust that the eleventh installment of the Chronicles of Rodovia series has sparked your eagerness to seize the throne and guide your kingdom to prosperity and glory! 

You can be sure that we will soon publish more interesting information and news about the game, just like the next parts of our Chronicles 😁 Stay hyped, stay tuned, and add Crown of Greed to your Steam wishlist. Thank you, Rulers!

notes.title: New information on Crown of Greed release window
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Today, we bring you a single, yet crucial announcement. Countless players have been asking about the date of the full release of Crown of Greed, and we believe in keeping our conversations with you clear and honest. That’s why it’s time to address the most frequently asked question across our Social Media, Discord server, and Steam discussions.


The Crown of Greed release window is set on early 2026
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/040c65c16916b4da51a08b64bd885af45172c5c5.png

This means you'll reclaim the throne of Rodovia once again in the early months of next year. While that may seem far off, we’re confident that time will pass in the blink of an eye. We are very keen to give you the opportunity to play Crown of Greed as soon as possible, but this will not happen until we are sure that we have done everything in our power to make the title as polished, extended and fun as possible. Speaking of which...


Warm reception of the Demo and further decisions
[hr][/hr]
The Demo version was met with great enthusiasm by players worldwide. Beyond the wealth of valuable feedback we’ve received, this positive reception was an important message in itself. And so, thanks to the successful Demo version, we gained additional resources to develop the project even further than originally planned. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/dbbb4a0019eb089a5f915477d2b5aa5dccca40bb.gif

Know, that it was you - the community - who had a huge role in this important decision, and that we will continue to do whatever we can to listen to your opinions and try to implement your cool ideas into the game. Yet again, you've demonstrated your passion and unwavering support, and for that, we are truly grateful.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


What do we plan to achieve with this extra time?
[hr][/hr]
Every extra day is worth its weight in gold here, and we gained quite a few of them! And although we are still in the planning phase, and many details are yet to be finalized, we can already share that you can look forward to:

➡️ a set of completely new systems and mechanics designed to differentiate Crown of Greed from the Majesty series while still remaining true to the core gameplay concepts. Examples? Here we go:
- the option to give names to your favorite heroes, transfer them between scenarios or even resurrect fallen champions 
- day & night system
- the new option allowing you to choose your royal banner
- the totally new decrees system, which we will tell you more about in the future. For now, we can spoil that they increase the variation between subsequent scenarios... according to your choices

➡️ at least one additional hero class and two new enemy type compared to what we planned for the original release. Once again, we don't want to spoil them yet, as they need an appropriate presentation, but these are the classes you asked for most often in your suggestions

➡️ extensive campaign system
- numerous, varied scenarios, each with its own setting, variables and victory conditions
- additional "tower defense" scenarios focusing on defending the base, which is attacked by increasingly larger waves of enemies
- a new system that will allow you to spend earned points between scenarios to unlock new buildings, technologies, heroes skills and so on; now you will be able to shape your own unique playstyle!

➡️ lots of balance changes, better AI of player units and enemies, tons of general improvements and fixes, a number of other minor changes or additions

➡️ numerous Quality of Life changes

➡️ animation improvements

➡️ sounds and audio improvements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/6e44ec63d335e7e57bd697963c25e742ed7aa1f0.gif

More info coming soon!
[hr][/hr]
As time goes by, we will certainly be able to share more details and specific information. We'd love to tell you all about them in the future, so be sure to stay tuned! We trust that the additional production time for Crown of Greed will greatly enhance its quality, and we hope this decision will be met with your support.

Thank you, your Grace!

notes.title: Chronicles of Rodovia #10 - Druids and Arbalesters
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/4832afc6e1977e345c3288ced2ed374cf2989bcc.png

Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


Today, we're back with more of what you love the most... namely the heroes! 🤩 It's time to meet another pair of intrepid adventurers who (for a right gold fee, of course) will take on the quests you assign them. Though their skills, roles, and ways of life are very different, they can still come together to serve the glory of your kingdom.

Behold, rulers. The Druid and the have just arrived at the gates of your city.


Power of nature - Druids 🌿
[hr][/hr]
Druids are mysterious guardians of nature, able to communicate with primal forces and use them to fight their enemies. Their arsenal of deadly skills includes elemental and nature magic and even animal control.

While Druids have many strengths, they excel as a ranged unit and struggle in close combat - luckily, their summoned forest companions step in to assist 🐻 This hero archetype is eager to venture out into the wilderness, beyond the confines of the city, and is reluctant to undertake attack missions. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/9aa7a96b6055b90bf120222ae27fcdf1080861e6.png

Druid abilities ✨
[hr][/hr]
When forced into battle, the Druid will not hesitate to call upon his most fearsome abilities. This servant of nature is, for example, able to fire a magical boulder that damages and stuns enemies. He can also summon a group of aggressive ravens to swarm and attack enemies on his behalf 🐦‍⬛ 

In terms of defensive abilities, Druids can summon a solid, thick shield of ice or call upon bears and wolves to aid them. Once their opponent realizes who they are dealing with and flees, Druids can bind them with magical roots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/3c8023f4e750af807fffd27da351fcc61a4faad3.gif

The Tree of Elements 🌳
[hr][/hr]
The Druids' quarters is one of the most unique structures in the entire world of Rodovia. Once you choose where you want to place it... your work is done! The Tree of Elements does not need builders, scaffolding and nails like other structures - it will take root on its own and start growing until it becomes a fully-fledged seat of guardians of the nature! 🌱

The same is true for repair - when the Tree of Elements is damaged, it will heal on its own. Your workers don't have to risk their lives to get close to a besieged building in order to repair it, which can be crucial later in the game.



Need to shoot something? Hire Arbalesters 🎯
[hr][/hr]
Arbalester is an experienced shooter who has mastered the use of the powerful arbalest and other crossbows to perfection. His main advantage is huge firepower, which should be feared by even the most dreadful enemies. Arbalester may not be the fastest or the most durable unit, but in ranged combat he has no equal. Keep this in mind, especially when large beasts appear on your borders - they are the favorite target of this severe marksman.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/299281e2fd40e4aad10139ef8da49d8e647f40c6.png

Arbalester abilities ✨
[hr][/hr]
As the most skilled marksmen in the realm, Arbalesters possess a vast array of abilities. Their primary attack is a devastating shot from an immense crossbow, but they have more than a few surprises up their sleeves. Examples? Of course! They can unleash fiery bolts to set enemies ablaze 🔥, fire piercing projectiles that damage multiple targets, or strike weak points to cause bleeding.

Arbalesters are also equipped with deadly grenades, ideal for dealing with large enemy groups. When faced with danger, they stand their ground and activate the "Fortress" skill, allowing them to fortify their position and rain down shots on approaching foes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/8aef8f232ff084367729c76d6e337935a6c65871.gif

Shooter’s Workshop 🏹
[hr][/hr]
Arbalesters spend their free time at Shooter's Workshop. Unlike the Druids, they are known as city and civilization types, and are rather reluctant to undertake reconnaissance missions. And while these extraordinary shooters are very intriguing and unique individuals, their headquarters seem quite ordinary... except for one detail.

Any uninvited guest can expect to be greeted by a precise shot from a mighty ballista mounted on the Shooter’s Workshop tower! 💀 That's right! The Arbalesters home is a weapon in itself. With the support of nearby watchtowers and their guards, they become an excellent means of defending your city.

notes.title: Demo summary and a few words from the team 📜
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
The last few weeks have been a real rollercoaster for our entire team. Until the last moment before the release of the Crown of Greed Demo, we refined and improved the gameplay to make your adventure in the world of Rodovia as fun and immersive as possible.

We raced against time to get rid of the most frustrating bugs, balance the economy and combat system, improve NPC behavior, or add new cool features to the game, so that we are ready to take part in the Steam RTS festival. And now... we see that it was worth it 😃


A huge thank you to our community 💪
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/fb5395601e17cd28845c66b63c58fea046839663.png

As usual, you have proven what a great community you are, everyone. We received so many words of support, useful feedback, great suggestions and reports that they almost overwhelmed us! 

We spent long hours analyzing every single opinion you sent us, resulting in the first two Demo Hotfixes. What's more, we were extremely happy to see your reviews on Steam, thanks to which we managed to obtain the "very positive" rating 🤩

Seeing such great enthusiasm, you can be sure that this is not the end of our work on improving and developing the Crown of Greed project. With that in mind, let's talk about our plans for the future.


What's coming next? 🛠️
[hr][/hr]
It's too early to promise anything for sure, but a few elements came up among your feedback most often, which indicated the direction we want to go.

➡️ First of all - more missions and a campaign. The world of Rodovia is a diverse, dangerous, but also beautiful land that has much to offer. We will invite you to explore (and conquer) all its corners! 

➡️ Voice Acting - we realize that it is currently somewhat generic, and we will do our best to improve it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/a3ec2088e588a2ecfa0efe82b2e7bff35811bf17.png

➡️ UI and QOL improvements - thanks to your feedback, we know how much these elements affect the fun of the game. We will work hard to make it as clear and useful as possible.

➡️ Balance changes - strength of monsters, gaining experience by heroes, amount of taxes, HP of buildings, spawning rates and... and everything else will be further analyzed and refined.

➡️ Among your requests, there was often a question about resurrecting your favorite heroes and transferring them between scenarios. We will make it happen!

➡️ We are working on a few new mechanics and an innovative system which will further diversify the gameplay. We are currently exploring a few intriguing ideas, so that Crown of Greed will have even more to offer!

We could go on and on, and list even more changes, such as the deeper relations between heroes and the player, new kinds of monsters, spells and buildings, but we are sure you get the idea. The game will certainly evolve and expand, and we will discuss all the novelties in more detail in the near future.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png



For now - let's enjoy the Demo and try to beat it in the Nightmare mode 💀
[hr][/hr]
Can you believe that some of you managed to do it? We're honestly surprised that you were able to beat the game on the hardest difficulty setting... which is another lesson for us. We will be sure to prepare even more challenges for you in the future, with even more deadly enemies and surprising events. Once again, thank you, everyone. We will speak to you soon!


Good luck in Rodovia, Rulers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/c33c7318b4f6e4326bdb6d32adb78d1f3cc4a204.png

Those of you who took part in our Playtest are certainly wondering what new things await you this time, however we will come back to this topic a little bit later. Let us start by welcoming the new players, who haven't played Crown of Greed before and don't really know what they can expect. Here are some tips to help you understand the rules you'll have to follow:


▶️ Economy
Upon entering the world of Rodovia, you’ll face the task of building your first foothold, which will provide your subjects with shelter and grant you priceless gold from taxes 🪙 Each building you have built, such as a Forge, Market, Inn and others will generate gold collected by the Tax Collector. Unless your Collector is torn to shreds by wolves, giant spiders, devils or other dangerous creatures, your treasury will be full.

▶️ Spendings
You can use the money earned from taxes, running trading posts and destroying enemy nests to expand your city and defend it with a system of defense towers. You can also build Hero habitats where you can recruit the bold adventurers and upgrade their abilities. 

▶️ Heroes
Nothing speaks to the courage and conscience of heroes like shiny coins. You can't control them directly, but you can pay them to encourage them to perform various types of contracts, such as reconnaissance, defense of a selected area, or attack. With successful contracts, your heroes will gain experience and develop their skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/cd63734bb3a80b15165e7253b8393149fb9a9a0b.gif

▶️ Enemies
Your city is regularly attacked by various creatures. To prevent this, you must develop appropriate defense systems and deploy your heroes to destroy enemy-generating habitats. Be cautious, though, as enraged foes may launch large, coordinated attacks on your borders.

▶️ Player's actions
You, as a powerful Ruler, can also take part in battle using the spell system. You can also manage the power of a coin. It's up to you how much gold you offer your heroes for completing a given mission. Can you find the balance and make them obey you?

notes.title: Chronicles of Rodovia #9 - In defense of your kingdom 🛡️
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png

The truth is that the enemies of your kingdom never sleep and are constantly looking for new ways to end your reign 💀 With this in mind, you must always be ready to repel the attacks of beasts that come at you from the surrounding forests, swamps or snowy plains, ready to risk everything to slay you and your loyal subjects. Fortunately, there is a way to stop them...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/aecb1572e6dce6858673962d7f42b7f02b66847b.png

It's all about safety ✊
[hr][/hr]
The inhabitants of the realm of Rodovia know well that strong defense is the basis of their survival. That's why they have perfected a system of diverse defense towers that are designed to keep their borders safe. Your task as king will be to decide on their number, location and types - all this to kill every foe that dares to set foot on your territory! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/aeb041468841ecd0d4e90523c5a12817609ba041.gif

Types of defense towers at your disposal 🏰
[hr][/hr]
1️⃣ Guard Tower - Level 1 - The most basic defensive structure in your arsenal, that can be very helpful in the early stages of the game. It's not very durable, its damage isn't as high as other towers, and its range leaves a lot to be desired, but it's still great against weaker invaders.

2️⃣ Guard Tower - Level 2 - A larger, more durable, stronger and simply better version of the previous tower. When you feel the enemy pressure getting stronger, consider upgrading a few towers to level 2. We are sure you will feel the difference.

3️⃣ Observer Tower - Level 3 - Second-level towers can be upgraded into three variants. 
The first one is the Observer Tower, whose task is to spot enemies from long distances to give you valuable time to prepare your defense. Of course, it's still manned by shooters, but its damage output isn't very high... compared to its view range, which is roughly three times that of the Level 2 Guard Tower.

3️⃣ Gunner’s Tower - Level 3 - The structure that your enemies fear the most - manned by twice as many shooters, who send their projectiles towards the invaders at astonishing speeds. It is a durable, deadly tower that can be the core of your defense. 

3️⃣ Dam Tower - Level 3 - By far the most resistant and durable defensive structure in your kingdom. The speed of its shooters may not be that great, but the damage they deal is unmatched. Destroying this type of tower takes a lot of time, and during the process, the invaders are constantly exposed to fire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/8f9abfa0d16bd928c323e0baba4559f32c61165f.png

Other ways to keep your cities safe 💪
[hr][/hr]
The defensive towers themselves, although powerful, may sometimes prove to be insufficient ☠️ Remember not to neglect the recruitment of soldiers and heroes who will not only support the operation of the towers, but can also destroy the habitats of enemies who attack your settlements. You must not forget, that some hero classes are perfect for defensive tasks, while others are better suited for reconnaissance missions and those aimed at destroying monster dens. Choose wisely! 


The horde mode 😈
[hr][/hr]
Although this mode is still in quite an early stage of development, we still want to tell you a few words about it. In this mode, defense becomes even more important and becomes your main task as the king 👑 You can think of it as a kind of Tower Defense, in which you will be attacked by huge waves of enemies... and we mean it, when saying huge! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/cd63734bb3a80b15165e7253b8393149fb9a9a0b.gif

As mentioned earlier, we're still developing the Horde Mode, and we'll share more exciting details once we have something interesting to reveal. Meanwhile, we hope you enjoy this sneak peek!

We hope you are not afraid of shadows, because today we will visit the dark alleys of your kingdom. In such places, your greatest value is your cunning and your dagger, so watch your back, ok? Our hero's watchful eyes will certainly follow us closely... 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/f7ac9da71c1d55ea79b51cfccd8601ee843d8fa2.png

The greediest of them all - meet the Rogue 💰
[hr][/hr]
Although many of the heroes in your service value virtues ​​​​such as honor, discipline and loyalty, all of them love shiny coins. Well, that's just the nature of our dear adventurers. However, one of them stands out significantly when it comes to their love of gold... 🤑 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/2f7e5a50ed669f31bfe224c9c111a2b6c2e8704e.png


Our today's hero is so greedy that he may even decide to reach for your treasury! No, you didn't mishear, Rogues hold no loyalty beyond their own pockets and may rob your kingdom's workshops and other buildings! Nonetheless, this is a price many rulers are willing to accept, as they realize what powerful allies these shadow masters are.


The more you know... 🧐
[hr][/hr]
But what makes Rogues such desirable characters? Let's discuss a few facts and information about this rebellious adventurer ✊ Based on them, it will be easier for you to decide whether you consider them valuable partners or a threat: 

• Rogues are willing to take on tasks of any type, although they will carefully analyze the risks and potential gains before accepting it

• They are famous for their tactical, cautious approach to combat

• They are focused on ruins and other resourceful locations where sizable amounts of gold can be found - Rogues are perfect for scouting this type of structures

• Unsurprisingly, this type of hero loves to spend time in taverns and gambling dens

• Shadow Masters are known for their proficiency with daggers. They know exactly where to hit to hurt! They can poison their blades, finish off wounded targets, and even throw their knives

• It is said that the most proficient Rogues can simply vanish in the air...

Syndicate of the Sticky Fingers ✋

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/d5461dffa410c8395130c9ccc6af581a5b09b798.png

Syndicate of the Sticky Fingers, as it is called, can be upgraded up to Tier III, allowing your Rogues to hone their skills and experience. Make no mistake, a trained representative of this profession is a powerful weapon... at your command!

As we mentioned above, Rogues are always careful in choosing their tasks and avoid fighting opponents who are clearly stronger than them. We wonder if they would take on the mission to defeat the beast we want to present to you today... 🌲 Brace yourselves, Rulers, we're off to the forest!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/95ff0a659969665c3f9d53b5386f9723f240913a.gif

notes.title: Chronicles of Rodovia #7 - Economy Buildings 🔨
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully.

Today we will look at 4 buildings that are among the economic pillars of your kingdom. This means that one of your tasks will be to make them appear in your realm as quickly as possible. After all, we don't want us to miss out on important opportunities and... gold coins 🤑 due to their absence, do we, your Grace?


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


Profitable, useful and important 🏛️
[hr][/hr]
This is the simplest way to describe the buildings we will examine in today's entry. As you know, most things in Crown of Greed revolve around cash, and its constant inflow is one of the conditions for your success. 

Fortunately, there are several ways to fill your treasury and gain some very interesting options of development at the same time. And This is where Blacksmith, Alchemist's Shop, Marketplace and Trading Post come to the rescue! 😁

Blacksmith 🔨
[hr][/hr]
A powerful weapon that strikes terror into the hearts of your opponents? Impenetrable armor providing great protection? Or maybe another great item that will increase your chances on the battlefield? Blacksmith has them all! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/a5d2a342bc2ee339d4b8063262cec6be9aca3000.png

You can think of a Blacksmith as of an extremely important workshop where your heroes can spend their hard-earned money to improve their equipment. Thanks to a wide selection of weapons, they will be able to deal more damage, and thanks to varied armor, they will be able to better protect themselves from injuries. What's more, the building can be upgraded, offering even more powerful items! ⚔️

The Blacksmith becomes increasingly important, particularly in the later stages of the game, when heroes' missions grow significantly more challenging and perilous compared to the early game. However, the earnings coming from the heroes' pockets are not everything. This workshop also generates passive income and is regularly visited by your tax collector. As you can see, Blacksmith is a real goldmine!


Alchemist's Shop 🍵
[hr][/hr]
This building will become available in your city during a later phase of the game, as it necessitates an upgraded Castle to be built. Just as a Blacksmith, Alchemist's Shop also generates passive income for your kingdom, being a stable source of your income. However, this is where the similarities end...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/36a75cf36e9b47f9479b7a0bb0ae795a8f78c504.png

The Alchemist's Shop is the workplace of witches who have perfected the art of preparing potions and elixirs 🔮 Once you develop the right technology, they will be able to prepare really powerful blends, which will significantly increase the capabilities of your heroes.

Such potions can not only heal their wounds, but also increase strength, endurance and other features necessary in the adventurer's craft. Unlike weapons and armor, potions are consumable goods that need to be replenished regularly... which is good news! The more heroes visit your Alchemist's Shop, the more cash they will leave behind. Be sure to upgrade this building as you progress through the game to meet the needs of your hired adventurers!



Marketplace ⚖️
[hr][/hr]
Marketplace is quite a unique building... but still shares some features with the previous two. Similar to the Blacksmith and Alchemist's Shop, this place offers heroes a range of items to buy, including magical artifacts (such as rings or trinkets) and consumable goods. Moreover, adventurers can also sell unnecessary items from their stash here. Making a long story short, Marketplace is a place where you can buy and sell all kinds of wares and merchandise! But that's not all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/f3fb7ab47695683a026e32841abb8276b3dfe529.png

At the beginning, when the Marketplace is still a modest, unimproved building 🛠️ it will only offer the most basic items. Over time, when you meet the appropriate requirements, you will be able to upgrade it and increase its product range. By unlocking new technologies, truly powerful items will appear on the Marketplace shelves, making heroes visiting your city eager to see and buy them!

In addition to generating passive income and drawing the tax collector, the Marketplace has another important role: it is a hub for visiting trade caravans. Caravans are responsible for transporting gold and other resources in the Kingdom from one predetermined point to another... but that's a story for another day.


Trading Post 💰
[hr][/hr]
Only rulers who have already built a Marketplace can establish a Trading Post, and these can only be built in remote, designated locations. Therefore, they force you to occupy distant, unexplored areas. The further away you establish a Trading Post, the more gold it will bring into your treasury... and the more vulnerable it will be to attacks! 💀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/490733026a943b3f42847d78ca13c1b7de8fe052.png

The Trading Post itself does not passively generate gold, but it does periodically generate caravans that are heading to your city. Without going into too much detail, as we will talk about caravans in a separate post, when such a trade expedition reaches its destination, you will earn a certain amount of cash.

The higher the tier of a Trading Post, the better and more frequent caravans it generates. Moreover, thanks to such an upgrade, the building can start defending itself against enemy attacks. While this is for sure a useful feature, it's rare for a Trading Post to be able to defend itself... but after all, that's what it has you for - the King, protector of the realm!

Today we will venture deep into your royal treasury. Will we find piles of gold and shiny coins there? Or will we be struck by its emptiness and long-abandoned cobwebs? 🕷️🕸️ In the harsh world of Crown of Greed, gold plays an extremely important role. 

Those who run out of funds will quickly discover that they are in real trouble. We don't want that to happen, do we now, Your Grace? Today's guide will help you understand how to keep your pockets full of gold coins and how to handle them efficiently. Time is money, so let's not waste another minute!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


Gold as the main resource in the world of Rodovia ⚖️
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/ccb20f9b63c26388436a283e18a9985edb3ed89a.gif

This slogan appears quite often today... but what exactly does gold allow you to do? Well, just after entering the game, you will discover that gold coins are necessary for numerous crucial activities. 

The most important services that a full treasury can provide you are:

• Building new structures available in the Castle panel
• Upgrading your Castle or other buildings
• Selecting a wide range of other upgrades for different aspects of your empire
• Recruiting new or resurrecting fallen heroes
• Casting powerful spells
• Activating special abilities of your buildings
• Offering messy jobs to your heroes

As you can see, the list is quite long! Now, knowing how useful gold is, you can probably guess that obtaining it is not easy. A wise ruler must learn how to spend and acquire new resources in order to provide their kingdom with a constant balance 🤔 So... how can you get your hands on priceless gold?


Different ways to get rich 🤩
[hr][/hr]
One of the easiest ways to improve the royal budget is to collect taxes in the Castle. After all, you are the King and collecting taxes is your sacred duty! And while collecting taxes in the Castle itself is quite easy, the subsequent stages of this process are much more tricky.

The Tax Collector will prove to be a very important figure here. His task is to visit the buildings of your empire and collect the due tribute 💰 And so, your emissary may knock on the door of economy buildings such as Market, Forge, or Alchemist, independently built structures like Windmill or Worker's House, or even the Headquarters of Heroes. Once the Tax Collector manages to take his planned route through the various places in your subordinate area, all he has to do is return to the Castle or one of the watchtowers... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/8458103aaec4c4ee00bdb222c9275d69b756fa90.gif

Unfortunately, many pairs of eyes eagerly glance at the bags full of gold coins carried by your Tax Collectors. If he wanders the far reaches of your kingdom or is left unprotected, his life, and even worse, the taxes he has collected, may be lost! 😱 If you decide to spend some of your funds to assign him protection, his job will become much easier and safer.

Speaking of which, Heroes will be perfect as such bodyguards. Even though they will gladly accept your coins, they are also, in a sense, the source of your income. For example, if the mission you assigned them is successful, they will give you back some of the funds obtained during their expedition. How generous!


Life of a Hero ✊
[hr][/hr]
One of your main tasks as King will be to assign the mentioned missions to your Heroes. It will be up to you to determine the risk, the price you are willing to pay, and to choose the right types of adventurers for the job 💀 Make no mistake, your Heroes are no fools and value their lives very much. That's why... they often go shopping!

(Work in Progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/8a04965d9657c400b6870bdd685969d6e398dbe8.gif

And that is how the money you pay them to do the bloody work may go back into your treasury. If you provide your heroes with the right conditions, they will willingly spend some of their money on improving their gear or potions that can increase their effectiveness 💪 When you grant them access to, for example, your blacksmith, they can upgrade their combat equipment. This way, cash circulates in a continuous cycle among the borders of your kingdom. The key is to strike the right balance.

notes.title: Chronicles of Rodovia #5 - Life of a Hunter 🏹
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully.

Today we will venture into the wilderness. And it's not just about an ordinary forest, but about unexplored lands, misty thickets and woods inhabited by deadly creatures. This is what the life of a Hunter is like - dangerous, yet full of bold deeds and adventures ✊ Care to share one?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


The wilderness holds no secrets... 🌲🐗
[hr][/hr]
While most people feel most comfortable among the city streets, castles, and homes of their kin, your kingdom will also have free spirits who prefer something... entirely different. Their home isn't stone walls, but a sleeping bag in the forest. Their roof isn't shingles, but a sky full of stars. Finally, their dream is not a warm meal by the fireplace, but an eternal journey and discovering the unknown. Meet Hunters - the greatest wilderness experts whose services can change the face of your empire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/00854119b3a7a55672a5fe78ce4b7ec98bb78cd6.png

To broaden and solidify your power as a ruler, you'll frequently need to take risks and venture into new wild territories. However, not all heroes are willing to undertake such expeditions - sometimes it does not suit their character, sometimes they simply lack the appropriate skills. Fortunately, Hunters are always happy to take on such a challenge, as their specialty is long journeys and reconnaissance missions 🦶

Hunters are known for their speed and excellent eyesight, which allows them to uncover larger areas than other units. Their weapon of choice is the iconic bow and arrow. They attack silently, quickly and effectively, which is why their opponents often do not even see what hit them! 💥 

This, combined with their eternal pursuit of adventures and freedom, ensures that Hunters are always happy about undertaking exploration missions.


Hunters Camp 🏹 Recruit the best of the best 
[hr][/hr]
Did you know that Hunters deal more damage against beasts than other heroes? Do you know why they are famous for their speed and scouting abilities mentioned above? The secret, apart from the experience gained in the field, lies in their training. Hunters Camp isn't only a place where you can recruit these agile wanderers, but it's also their training ground where they hone their craft.

With practice, your Hunters can enhance their skills, mastering new, even more deadly shooting techniques... of course, if they live long enough.  Their camp serves as a safe place to rest between missions, as well as a point where they exchange stories with their brethren. Therefore, you should always consider allocating additional funds to enhance this building, so the heroes have the optimal environment for their growth 🎯 The better the Hunters are, the better service they will be able to provide you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/b7cdc1dcbc494db157ba4da9cbe4516f3947e54b.png

Thanks to good knowledge of the surrounding areas and the ability to carry out missions in distant corners of your empire, you can gain a significant advantage over your opponents. Make no mistake, such challenges are never easy and only well-trained adventurers can cope with them ⚔️ Hunters, although specific and preferring to work alone, will undoubtedly demonstrate their value to you on many, many occasions.


Basilisk - one of the beasts you can hunt 😈
[hr][/hr]
As you traverse various hunting grounds, it is more than certain that you will encounter many deadly dangers 💀 Welcome to the world of Rodovia! Among these dangers we can mention many entities - undead, cursed ones, demons, greenskins... or beasts, which are the Hunters' specialty. Thanks to extensive training and experience shared among members of this profession, Hunters are more than capable of facing bloodthirsty beasts, and they won't back down from horrors such as giant spiders, vipers, or wolves 🐺

And while these all are very dangerous creatures, they are still far from the Basilisk...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/d723609ce2ae3ec53756d3c00aa2012312e305cd.png

You see, your Majesty, Hunters encounter many beasts in their careers, but after encountering a Basilisk, these careers often end in a violent and bloody way. Only the most experienced and well-equipped veterans are able to deal with this gigantic, lizard-like creature. Oh, did we mention that it can... fly? To make matters worse, the Basilisk's direct gaze can turn its prey to stone 😱 If legends are to be believed, this mysterious monstrosity can be found in long-forgotten dungeons and the thickest forest.

With this in mind, be sure to double-check that your Hunters are capable of defeating this unique beast - the loss of a proven hero can be severe, and the replacement of his role can be long-lasting. Don't be surprised if the Hunter asks for a large sum of gold for undertaking such a difficult mission 💰 Where there is a great challenge, there is a great reward, as they say. In the end, you alone must assess the balance of costs and benefits of eliminating the dreadful Basilisk from your lands.

Arm yourself with courage and some good, sharp steel, your Majesty - today we will take a closer look at the Undead forces and the bloodthirsty Devils, one of the most deadliest foes of your Realm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


Dangers lurk everywhere 💀
[hr][/hr]
Evil abhors a vacuum. It greedily extends its clawed paws wherever it is not vigorously fought. As you know, the situation is similar in the Realm of Rodovia, the defense of which is your sacred duty. While expanding your kingdom and discovering new frontiers, you are sure to encounter numerous deadly dangers, that may cause great harm to your people and your heritage 😱 This is why, as a ruler, you should thoroughly familiarize yourself with the horrors you and your warriors will face.

(Work in Progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/d336805b4cce922e54a44dd38ad4409909c0afcb.gif

Fortunately, as always, you can count on the help of your scribes and sages, who will tell you all about the foes of the realm under your reign. Today we will look into deep, dark caves and visit the crumbled walls of haunted strongholds. On this day, we will delve into the empty eyes of the undead soldiers, and hear the terrifying roar of giant, dark-magic corrupted demons. Knowing your enemy is half the battle, so be sure to stay vigilant. Here we go!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/e23dc0fbc4768aee83f8b839c2c6c7f480bdd9c0.png

The undead never sleep 🦴
[hr][/hr]
Undead warriors feel no fear, cold, or hunger, and will not shrink from any danger. Their bones, deprived of their own will, are completely dispassionate and devoted to the bloody desire to kill the living. It's hard to say the same about their opponents - when seeing their empty eye sockets and the tattered remains of skin and tendons, they have every right to be terrified ☠️ 

The undead, apart from their hideous appearance and mysterious aura, have another terrifying feature - they cannot be expected to show even the slightest signs of mercy. Having that in mind, it seems they have no weaknesses. However...

There are several effective ways to send them to the grave, the very place where they belong. Obviously, undead do not bleed, so slashing and stabbing weapons are not as effective against them as blunt weapons. This is the first weakness of these monsters - strong, confident blows with war hammers or clubs. Additionally, skeleton warriors are not known for being master strategists and will often attack you as soon as they encounter your units, often one at a time, with no support. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/35b3e4ba830c954e6ef6da8088b2be66e10051c4.png

You can expect such reckless attacks from units called the Undead Warrior and the Undead Crossbowman. They can often be found wandering aimlessly around their dens. The situation changes when an Undead Captain appears in their company. This mysterious and deadly creature is able to control the undead around it and form them into troops. Needless to say, a group of skeleton fighters is much more dangerous than any individual unit. Especially when we consider the murderous abilities of the Captain himself.

It is worth knowing that undead beings often inhabit forgotten, mossy ruins. The places where they can be found include Cemeteries, Dungeons, Ruined Castles, haunted Towers and other similar terrifying locations. They are also common in desolates known as Deathlands. Remember to always remain vigilant when sending your heroes into such places 👀 If they fail, their bones will strengthen the armies of the undead.


Devils - a horror that makes your heroes shiver 😈
[hr][/hr]
This time we will face a flesh and blood enemy. It's true - Devils, as living creatures, can bleed and get hurt or tired, but this does not mean that they are an easy opponent. Not at all. Just one glance is enough to see what a deadly force they are - huge, massive bodies, incredibly strong arms wielding axes as tall as an adult man or powerful hooves that make the ground tremble are just to begin with. However, their most terrifying feature is their horned, skinless skulls and red, demoniacal eyes that can break the will of even the greatest warrior. Knowing that Devils belong to one of the most terrifying types of enemies - demons - makes it hard to blame them.

Devilish Tormentors, because this is the name of the unit you can see below, relies on their brute strength and high endurance 💪 Just see how easily it overpowered the charge of two hapless guards.

(Work in Progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/cd23c054275ad4d02121f18e7e7bc0a047e44218.gif

Speaking of strength and endurance, you need to know that Devils are resistant to several types of effects, such as stun or petrification. Their mighty skulls are far too thick to daze them, and their demonic roots too deep to turn them into the stone. Keep this in mind when choosing the heroes you send on the mission to slay these terrifying beasts! ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/c3c80cf1e4ec0e7e051401d65c9278947af6a45c.png

The best way to defeat the Devils is to use the numerical advantage. While this type of enemy is quite adept at fighting a few opponents at the same time and can attack multiple targets with a single swing, even it cannot avoid defeat when surrounded. We must not forget how durable this creature is and how many blows it takes to bring it down. The other way to kill them is to use an experienced, well-equipped hero. Only such battle-hardened adventurers have any chance in single combat against these demoniacal beings. However, such an assignment is very dangerous... and it certainly won't be cheap.

Devils tend to dwell in gloomy and foggy places, such as dark, cold caves. They often patrol the surroundings of their dens, looking for opportunities to fight and wreak havoc. If, while exploring the world of Rodovia, you come across a cave yawning with sinister darkness, know that it is very likely occupied by these bloodthirsty demons. Devils may not be very fast, but if you disturb their peace, they won't let you go unpunished.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/43d6b80c59c0c43205c2fce1e04482f0a507e23f.png

As a farewell, we can only wish you that these ferocious beasts will be a rare visitor to your cities. Their immense strength and durability may cost the lives of many of your subjects. Make no mistake... they will take every opportunity to soak their weapons in human blood 🩸 so be sure you'll be ready when they come.

notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully.

And now... let us tell you more about the two first hero archetypes - Warrior and Berserker ✊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png


The heroes await your orders... if you are generous enough
[hr][/hr]
As you probably already know, in Crown of Greed you will have the opportunity to utilize a rather unique, indirect commanding system. If you, as a King, want to bend someone to your will (in this case the proud heroes) you must first offer them something in return. Fortunately, adventurers aren't too picky in this area and will always settle for a purse full of shiny coins 💰 

(Work in Progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/a1086bc3b1093f4334f0c11e728a83a330c32c79.gif

For those who joined us only today - you can learn more about the general commanding system in the Chronicles of Rodovia Part #1 » 

But before we spend our hard-earned gold from our royal treasury, we must first decide which heroes best suit our needs. We must remember, that each hero class is quite different and is best for different types of tasks. Having that in mind, today we will take a closer look at two of them: Warrior and Berserker ⚔️ Let's see how their extraordinary skills and bravery can benefit our kingdom!

Warrior - the defender of the realm 🛡️
[hr][/hr]
Although warriors are one of the most common hero classes in the world of Rodovia, it does not mean that they are ordinary or trivial. Warriors are typically regarded as the elite unit of an army, embodying qualities of strength, honor and loyalty ✊ Their presence on the battlefield can boost the morale of your troops, as Warriors are often ready to sacrifice their lives to defend their kingdom and rulers.

(Work in Progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/60151e4101c5057815e0b45ab45686e37a05e26c.png

Heroes of this class are famous for their exceptional defensive skills. They are able to take powerful hits and blows that would simply crush most other fighters 😵 Their equipment consists of heavy armor, a sword and a shield, which increase their strength and resilience even further. With the experience and wealth gained from the missions you assign them, Warriors, like all other hero classes, will evolve and improve. You can see an example of such a development path in the illustration above - the more battle-hardened and wealthier your fighters are, the better equipped and trained they become. Remember to take good care of your best Warriors - losing them can be really painful!

It should come as no surprise that the Warriors prefer defensive missions. They are known as good team players and are always happy to support other heroes, but they perform rather poorly in quests that require map exploration and long journeys. Keep this in mind when you decide to ask them for their help.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/9a1c654f18a17a9abd576b124b44317badc439a3.png

Consider Warriors as valiant protectors of your domains, unafraid to position themselves at the forefront and absorb the first enemy strike. They will be a perfect choice for both melee combat and in clashes with ranged units 🏹 which they will reach under the protection of their shields and heavy armor. Whenever you feel that your kingdom is in danger, you can confidently trust these fearless, extremely brave heroes.


Berserker - the destructive force for hire 💥🪓
[hr][/hr]
These fierce fighters are often the last sight of their enemies. Their hallmarks are huge two-handed axes, capable of piercing even the hardest armor or knocking down an enemy many times larger than the Berserker himself 💀 From their earliest years, they have been trained in the art of combat and survival, thanks to which their skills have become legendary... and highly desired by rulers who want to have them in their service.

(Work in Progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/bce7d1149e9177a0c1a024a23f3d3dc0834c7891.png

Berserkers possess unparalleled physical strength, which stands as their greatest advantage. Every muscle in their body is trained to perfection, and their every instinct is subordinated to survival and fighting. That's why they prefer to fight in close quarters - only then can they make full use of their gigantic, fabled axes 💪

Unlike Warriors, Berserkers will happily welcome news of a new attack-based mission. For a right price (and you must know that these brave fighters are known for their love of coins) they will march to the distant corners of your kingdom and wreak havoc among your enemies. You, as their leader, can be sure that they will do their best to maintain their glorious reputation. But between greed, fame and courage, there is also another feature often mentioned among their traits... 

(Work in Progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/0b914bc5a6d54562c8498bff785e682d1898d22e.png

Berserkers possess a deep-seated hatred towards green-skins 🤬 and when they spot one, they will do everything in their power to chop them with their powerful axes. Green-skins are the natural enemies of this proud people, and they share a centuries-long history of feuds, wars and insults. Woe to anyone who stands in the way of the enraged Berserker.

Their only weakness seems to be the dark magic that brings the undead hordes back to life. This is the only type of opponent they are not happy to face.

notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
Welcome to the Chronicles of Rodovia - a series designed to prepare you for ascension to the throne! 📖 Thanks to the following entries, you will learn how to manage your kingdom and your subjects, make crucial, even fateful decisions, and safeguard your reign from premature demise. In each subsequent post, we will take a closer look at a different gameplay element and explain the basic mechanics that govern the world of Crown of Greed, so be sure to follow them carefully, aight?

And now... your adventure is about to begin. It's time to get straight to the point!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/ba84024e444ebcc255208141a43debd4e8fbbd26.gif
Work in Progress

Crown of Greed and its most important feature
[hr][/hr]
If you are already familiar with the Crown of Greed project, you probably know that it is... quite different from most of the games of its genre. We are sure you will agree that the vast majority of strategy games are based on selecting specific units and giving them direct commands 👉 such as repairing your structures, attacking, building or collecting resources.

In the case of our game, however, the situation is totally different. Instead of having direct control over units, players participate in the life of their kingdom as if they were a part of it, rather than an all-powerful, controlling entity. And so, you can't simply select your units, oh no. What you will get is an array of management features and options, that MAY 👀 bend the independent inhabitants of the Land of Rodovia to your will.... or not!


Heroes are waiting to be hired
[hr][/hr]
The player's heroes live their own lives, making choices depending on the archetype. Some of them, for example, eagerly anticipate the upcoming battles, showing a greater inclination toward assignments focused on dismantling enemy units ⚔️ Meanwhile, those with a curiosity about the world and a traveler's spirit are more likely to choose reconnaissance missions. Remember, that in order to manage your heroes well, you must first get to know them and understand their strengths.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/88f48e2e35383ff1b98f0049b8cf4b544902d4fb.gif
Work in Progress

Which heroes decide to visit your city is based on your choices. Will you offer them access to a forge and thus better items? To an inn, where they can rest? Or to a marketplace where they can buy a variety of useful goods? How you direct the development of your kingdom will define which heroes will offer you their services... and how they will develop. This is important because both you and the heroes want them to be as powerful as possible - a real win-win situation! The death of such an experienced, well-equipped hero is a great loss! 💀


Your first Contracts
[hr][/hr]
Once you get to know your heroes and plan their path of development, it's time to send them for their first quests! You can assign them such quests using so called Contracts. While there are numerous varied missions and orders you can offer to your daring adventurers, we'll take exploring the undead-infested ruins as an example. 

When you locate an undead lair, you can assign one of the available heroes to go there and... do what heroes do 💥🦴 To persuade the hero to cooperate, you must create a Contract and then offer the adventurer appropriate remuneration. Fortunately, they exhibit a strong desire for gold. With this in mind, flag your target and then set a fee that you are willing to pay to the hero who will take up the challenge (naturally, the higher the reward, the greater the chance that a more powerful hero will take on the task). While completing missions, adventurers gain experience points and gold. They can then spend it in your city, which keeps cash in constant circulation!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/6c0af660fa2ec48ef5031ea9863240b98bef9220.gif
Work in Progress

Support your heroes
[hr][/hr]
When a hero goes on a mission, you don't have to stay idle and just wait for the outcome. As a powerful ruler, you can support them, for example, with powerful spells. Moreover, if one of them has become your favorite and has served your kingdom well, in some cases you will even be able to bring them back to life if they fall in a fierce battle 🤕

The decisions you make, and wise quest planning, are crucial for your heroes to be effective and more and more powerful. You have to remember, that the Berserker archetype is much better at missions that involve attacking, while the Paladin archetype prefers defending your city from harm. The Rogue will be perfect for eliminating important, but less durable targets, and the Hunter will gladly scout the surroundings of your castle. We are sure you get the idea!

notes.title: Welcome to the Crown of Greed - the unique RTS game with indirect control
notes.content:
Greetings, your Grace! 👑
[hr][/hr]
While the king's leadership and management skills play a key role in the kingdom's prosperity, its survival remains threatened without the assistance of its Heroes. Unfortunately, as many rulers have found out the hard way, these Heroes, despite their glorious qualities, can also prove to be... rather capricious or driven by lust for gold! 

Will you be able to bend your subjects to your will and oversee their actions? Will you ensure the well-being and safety of the realm? And finally, will you be able to reach an agreement with the mighty, independent Heroes? 

Welcome to “Crown of Greed” - an unusual RTS game featuring unparalleled and distinctive management and command systems! However, let us start from the very beginning…


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/007b2430acda99831c4405eb769bcd428a57edd4.png


Free will and a deep AI system as the gameplay driving force 🧠
[hr][/hr]

Your tale takes shape in the magical, Slavic-inspired realm of Rodovia, currently tormented by the enigmatic, incredibly intelligent and hellishly sinister dragon. Harnessing the power of dark magic that embraced the nearby barrows, forests, and long-forgotten tombs, life was breathed anew into a myriad of horrifying creatures. Naturally, no ruler can permit their land to be plagued by legions of undead, werewolves, vampires, or giant spiders, and the responsibility to shield your people from inevitable doom falls upon you… and Heroes of the realm.

And so, let’s start with one of the most unique features of the “Crown of Greed” project. Other games of this genre allow you to simply select specific units and issue commands with a few clicks of your mouse. And what if... NPCs had their own free will and extensive AI systems? What if you can't order them to do something, but you have to convince or even bribe them to do it? 

Due to the optimal balance of authority and the significant independence exhibited by all NPCs, you'll experience the genuine role of a ruler facing real difficulties and engaging challenges. Once you begin one of the selected missions (enhanced with additional procedurally generated elements) and explore the possibilities offered by your main, most important building - the Castle -  you will be ready to give your first commands.


Heroes and Contracts 📜
[hr][/hr]

Heroes, an essential element in achieving goals, can be for example induced to perform their tasks through so called Contracts. However, it is not always as simple as it may seem at first glance. Only an appropriate amount of gold or resources can convince them that it is worth taking the risk of executing such a Contract and putting their lives on the line. Therefore, one of the key skills that you will have to master will be good recognition of their needs - only then will you be able to offer them a deal they will agree to and keep your treasury relatively intact. Make no mistake, Heroes hold a deep fondness for gold, and we will delve into how they make use of it down below.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/0ae172f90dca795abcf57368319f30cc01f76058.png


Subjects and the Castle 🏰
[hr][/hr]

However, powerful Heroes are not your only means of achieving your goals. Your loyal Subjects, who are also endowed with advanced AI, await your Orders. Such Orders are used to issue tasks to all the player's direct Subjects, who do not require Orders. And so, they will carry out the Orders you approve in the special settlement management system. Being more specific, you can decide on how to collect taxes, prioritize the repair of damaged buildings, guard certain areas by your troops, or issue many, many other commands.

As mentioned above, the center of your rule will be the Castle. The Castle panel can be used to manage your lands, construct new buildings, issue Orders and Contracts or conduct numerous research. Moreover, structures are categorized into those you can construct manually and those that are spontaneously erected by your subjects. Buildings that are built by your people, such as farms, bakeries, mills, and agricultural fields are the main sources of coin (via taxes) which then go to the treasury. The higher the tier of your Castle, the more new management options you will unlock!


The Magic System ⚡
[hr][/hr]

The most active manifestation of your will as a King is Magic. Using specially selected spells, you can influence the very fate of your realm. They can for example directly hurt or weaken your enemies, support Heroes during their missions, or even have a positive effect on the buildings under your control! The Magic system, if properly used, can change the course of events and save your dominion and Subjects from any harm.


The in-game world and its characteristics 🧐
[hr][/hr]

With a grasp of the fundamental mechanics that make “Crown of Greed” unique among other games of this genre, it’s time for a more lore-based, immersive look. As you already know, after starting a new single-player campaign, you are introduced to the current situation of the kingdom that you inherited as your father's only heir. Now the realm has fallen victim to the attack of the malicious and cunning dragon and his dark magic.

Using a dedicated campaign map, you will have to choose one of the available missions, each with its own regions and objectives. At this point, it is worth mentioning that each of them is characterized by high replayability through procedurally generated random elements and the option to increase the difficulty level, and thus unlock special badges or increase your high score. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/4101df3e0527e280872a8cf1053d8b865f779e84.png


After choosing a mission, your trusted advisor will familiarize you with its goals and tell you what problems plague the selected area. With only your Castle, a handful of subjects and a few basic buildings at your disposal, you will have to expand your settlement and complete the mission objectives. Moreover, some of the missions have their own unique conditions and limitations that force you to try new, different strategies and development directions. 

Soon after, brave Heroes will appear at your gates, looking for an opportunity to gain fame and glory. How they spend the gold they earn from Contracts is entirely up to them... although as the king, you can influence their decisions. If you remain idle, they will probably drink away their money at a nearby inn or empty their pouches playing dice. On the other hand, there are ways to maximize their utility by providing them with an opportunity to evolve.

If you give your Heroes access to appropriate buildings or the means to grow, they will spend their coin on upgrading their equipment, training, or improving their combat abilities! But there’s more. Thanks to your Contracts, Heroes can explore nearby forests, hills and misty swamps in search of powerful artifacts and items that will further enhance their power. It would be a great loss to lose such a great Hero (which can happen quite often!), so remember to always properly estimate Contracts for their power level and capabilities.
